# Phillips & Prissy Andrews

- [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) — Romantically involved with — [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) — gave her Mayflowers and said 'sweets to the sweet' · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing their scenic route, local school gossip, and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). In the classroom, Gilbert pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and despite Gilbert's contrite apology afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to forgive him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed and accidentally jump on Diana's elderly [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious and threatening to leave.
>
